description: A Flutter widget implementation for displaying web content using WebView, with asset sanitization, resource management, and error handling.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a web view screen that loads local HTML assets with sanitization and asset validation.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class managing WebViewController, asset loading, sanitization, error handling, and UI updates.

methods.name: WebViewScreen
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebViewScreen with required assetPath.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for WebViewScreen.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState.initState
methods.description: Initializes WebViewController, sanitizes asset path, and starts asset preparation and loading.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState._sanitizeStrict
methods.description: Sanitizes the input path to enforce assets/<name>.html, removing traversal, query strings, and ensuring proper extension.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState._prepareAndLoad
methods.description: Loads the HTML asset, resolves references, checks for missing assets, and initializes WebView content based on platform.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState._findMissingReferences
methods.description: Parses HTML content for CSS, JS, and image references and verifies their existence in assets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, showing WebView, loading indicator, or error/missing assets messages.
